data.name: Private Romantic Sunset Cruise
data.headline: Three hours for two or up to six on the Atlantic horizon
data.description:
A three-hour private sunset cruise for couples — engagements, anniversaries, honeymoons, or just a special night for two. Your USCG-licensed captain keeps to himself (no narration, no third wheel), runs you offshore to the perfect Atlantic horizon, and gives you the Key West sunset you came here for. Champagne stops are welcome. We can pre-cool drinks aboard, set out bow cushions, and accommodate proposals — let us know in advance and the captain will set up the moment without ruining the surprise.

Quick facts:

• 3 hrs $995 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

data.itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet your captain at Dock A, Slip #32. After a brief safety overview, we cruise into calm evening waters as the golden hour begins.

Scenic Harbor & Coastal Cruise
Enjoy a relaxing ride past historic waterfront homes, harbor landmarks, and open Gulf or Atlantic waters. Keep an eye out for dolphins and seabirds as the sky begins its transformation.

Prime Sunset Positioning
Your captain selects the optimal viewing location based on wind and cloud patterns to ensure a spectacular sunset backdrop. Anchor or drift in a peaceful setting as the sky ignites with brilliant hues of orange, rose, and violet.

Toast the moment, take photos, enjoy music, and soak in uninterrupted panoramic views.

Twilight Return Cruise
As daylight fades, cruise back under soft evening skies with the lights of Key West beginning to glow along the horizon.

data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Romantic Sunset Cruise Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re honored to welcome you aboard your Romantic Sunset Cruise — a private 3-hour evening experience designed to capture Key West at its most magical.

Please review the important details below to ensure a seamless and unforgettable evening on the water.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Cruise

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

Please complete all required forms prior to arrival so we may depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🌅 Your Romantic Sunset Experience

This is a private 3-hour sunset charter designed for intimacy, elegance, and uninterrupted views.

Possible scenic routes may include areas near:

• Mallory Square Harbor
• Sunset Key
• Tank Island
• Wisteria Island
• Open Gulf horizon views

Your captain selects the ideal sunset location based on wind and cloud conditions to ensure the most spectacular vantage point.

Relax, play your favorite music, bring champagne, and watch the sky transform into brilliant hues of gold, rose, and violet.

Please note: Sunset timing, cloud cover, and color intensity vary daily and cannot be guaranteed — but every evening on the water is uniquely beautiful.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

Boat:
30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender
Private enclosed head (toilet)
USCG-certified safety equipment
Licensed USCG captains

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What’s Included

• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water & light snacks
• Comfortable seating
• Panoramic sunset viewing

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & beverages (BYOB welcome)
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain & crew gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

Open flames (candles, sparklers, etc.) are not permitted onboard.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Safety briefing provided prior to departure
• U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets available
• Routes selected based on wind and sea conditions
• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Guests should be in good general health and able to board the vessel with minimal assistance.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• Sunset visibility and color intensity vary daily
• All itineraries are subject to weather and captain discretion
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your cruise.

Make it a full evening.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

We look forward to sharing a beautiful Key West sunset with you.

Warm regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter
